Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies tetrahedral Li and Zn centers, each with four O neighbors, while Y centers show six O neighbors. The O-centered environments include one tetrahedral motif and several three-vertex or five-vertex arrangements. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Li tetrahedra sharing corners with one another and with Zn tetrahedra, while Zn tetrahedra also share edges with Y six-vertex polyhedra.
